SELECT 
  CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.XCL_011 = '+' THEN m.XCL_010 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / 
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.XCL_010)
FROM molecule m
INNER JOIN bond b ON m.XCL_010 = b.XCL_005
INNER JOIN connected c1 ON b.XCL_004 = c1.XCL_009
INNER JOIN atom a1 ON c1.XCL_007 = a1.XCL_001
INNER JOIN connected c2 ON b.XCL_004 = c2.XCL_009
INNER JOIN atom a2 ON c2.XCL_008 = a2.XCL_001
WHERE (a1.XCL_003 = 'n' AND a2.XCL_003 = 'p')
   OR (a1.XCL_003 = 'p' AND a2.XCL_003 = 'n')
